professionalSummary.text: Three years as project coordinator on a signalling renewals programme for a signalling contractor, keeping possession plans and works schedules current with contractor progress.
professionalSummary.witness: Three years as project coordinator on a signalling renewals programme for a signalling contractor: the possession plan and the works schedule for three renewal sites were mine to keep current each week from the contractor's reported progress.

experienceHighlights.text: Recorded possession briefings and site access permits under programme procedures, with infrastructure owner audit confirming no findings.
experienceHighlights.witness: The possession briefings and the site access permits on the three sites were recorded by me under the programme's procedures; the infrastructure owner audited the records twice and raised no findings.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared weekly progress reports for infrastructure owner's representative, with reports and comments stored in programme folder.
experienceHighlights.witness: The infrastructure owner's representative received my weekly progress report on each site, and the reports with the representative's comments are in the programme folder.

experienceHighlights.text: Tracked equipment deliveries against schedule in delivery log, noting queries settled by candidate and those requiring project manager's possession decision.
experienceHighlights.witness: Equipment deliveries were tracked by me against the schedule in the delivery log, which marks the delivery queries I settled with the suppliers and the ones that needed the project manager's possession decision.

experienceHighlights.text: Wrote hand-over notes at each commissioning stage, countersigned by commissioning engineer.
experienceHighlights.witness: Each commissioning stage on the three sites ended with my hand-over note, countersigned by the commissioning engineer.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample includes possession plan updates, possession briefing records, weekly progress reports, and commissioning hand-over notes with programme folder references.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: a month of possession plan updates, a possession briefing record, a weekly progress report and a commissioning stage hand-over note, with the programme folder references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Track safety card holder, able to attend site induction.
skills.witness: candidate holds the required track safety card and can attend the site induction next week; no relocation needed.
